title: Sprint G8 - honest kanban global board
description: SPRINT BRIEF (phase 6). The thin gorgeous layer: the console global board with one lane per project (or per initiative), columns mapped to derived statuses, Inbox and Next rails, and per-project staleness badges - all sourced from the aggregate rollup API and the global next queue. Writes are command invocations through the existing CLI JSON contracts: drag to In Progress issues work reserve, drag to Closed issues work close, and a drag that the runtime refuses (unsatisfied gates, unmet dependencies) snaps back with the enforcement gaps rendered - the board physically will not let a card lie. Never let the UI place a card in a state the runtime did not derive; the console adds zero private state beyond view preferences per docs/architecture/CONSOLE_APP.md. Depends on rollups (G4), global next (G6), and portfolio containers (G7) for initiative lanes.
acceptanceCriteria: All child tasks closed with passed verification evidence
